subject: SentryPay incident (May 23) - annotated timeline and mitigations
messages:
From: Alex Russo <ops@sentrypay.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: SentryPay Engineering <eng@sentrypay.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Incident on May 23 - request for post-incident summary and timeline

Hi David,

Thanks again for the quick engagement during yesterday's incident. Our on-call saw repeated 503s for the embeddings endpoint between ~02:37 and 03:08 UTC on May 23; the impact affected our batch ingestion pipeline and raised our error budget.

Can you please share a concise post-incident summary we can send to our internal stakeholders? We're specifically looking for:
- A short RCA (root cause) paragraph we can include in the exec readout
- An annotated timeline (timestamps + short notes)
- The actionable mitigations you've implemented and any scheduled follow-ups

If you have attachments (timeline PDF, checklist, logs snippets), please attach those. We also need confirmation of the rollback controls you used and whether there are any outstanding verification steps we should run on our side.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Russo
SentryPay — Head of Operations
ops@sentrypay.com

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Russo <ops@sentrypay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident on May 23 - annotated timeline and mitigations

Alex —

Appreciate the note and the clear asks. Attached are three artifacts: an annotated timeline (PDF), a mitigation checklist (XLSX), and a small logs snippets bundle we pulled for the affected window. Summary below; full detail in the attachments and the JIRA item linked at the bottom.

Quick RCA (1 paragraph):
During routine autoscaling events in one of our US-west Dedicated pools, an interaction between a newly-introduced kernel selection heuristic and the model's KV cache eviction policy caused excessive cache invalidations under a specific sequence-length mix. This increased per-request CPU scheduling overhead and led to transient 503 errors for long-running batch requests. No customer data was exposed.

Annotated timeline (high-level):
- 2027-05-23T02:35 UTC: First elevated 5xx rate observed by Redwood telemetry (automated alert).
- 2027-05-23T02:37 UTC: SentryPay reports increased failures to support.
- 2027-05-23T02:45 UTC: On-call incident lead initiated partial pool isolation for affected nodes.
- 2027-05-23T02:55 UTC: Rollback of recent kernel-heuristic change to the previous stable kernel selection applied.
- 2027-05-23T03:08 UTC: Error rates returned to baseline; monitoring kept at elevated scrutiny until 04:00 UTC.

Immediate mitigations we executed:
- Reverted kernel selection heuristic in the US-west Dedicated pool (completed 02:55 UTC).
- Isolated and drained the three nodes showing disproportionate eviction rates to prevent spread.
- Temporarily enforced a tighter sequence-length cap for batch jobs routed to the Dedicated pool while we validated fix.

Planned follow-ups and owners (in- flight):
- Marissa Cole (Platform Reliability): runbook updates and automated detection rules for eviction spikes — ETA 2027-06-03 (attachment: mitigation checklist).
- Hannah Schmitt (Runtime Eng): add a guard in the kernel selection path to prevent the heuristic from triggering with the observed workload profile — ETA 2027-06-10.
- David Kim (Ops): coordinate cross-check with your ingestion team to verify reduced error surface for your batch workload (I've included suggested verification steps in the checklist).

Verification for SentryPay (short):
1) Re-run your batch ingestion for the affected time-window at low throughput and confirm 2:37–03:08 UTC jobs now complete successfully.
2) If you see residual 5xx, capture one full request-id and send it to us; we'll correlate with our logs.

Attachments: sentrypay_annotated_timeline_20270523.pdf, sentrypay_mitigation_checklist_20270526.xlsx, sentrypay_logs_snippets_20270523.txt
Related link: JIRA-8892 (internal ticket with correlation logs) — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/JIRA-8892

If helpful, we can schedule a short technical readout with runtime engineers tomorrow.

— David
David Kim
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SentryPay incident (May 23) - internal action owners and verification plan

David / Hannah — forwarding Alex's ask and David's summary. I've taken notes on action owners and added a couple of internal checkpoints so we don't lose follow-through. Please reply inline with any adjustments.

Internal action register (short):
- Marissa: Update public runbook + add automated alert for KV eviction anomaly (ETA 2027-06-03). Done: draft present in the mitigation checklist.
- Hannah: Implement guardrail in kernel selection + unit tests (ETA 2027-06-10). Blocker: need reproducer for sequence-length mix; Diego has a partial replay.
- Neha: Coordinate capacity tuning recommendations with Dedicated infra; propose a safe autoscale window configuration (ETA 2027-06-07).
- David: Customer verification coordination + runbook signoff (ETA 2027-06-04).

Also proposed: run a post-fix soak for 72 hours after Hannah's patch merges; Marissa please add that to the checklist and set SLA for verification notifications to customers.

Marissa
Sr. Product Manager, Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Russo <ops@sentrypay.com>

Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SentryPay incident (May 23) - annotated timeline and mitigations

David — thanks for the quick and clear summary; the one-paragraph RCA will work for our exec readout. The attachments look good at a glance. A couple quick items:
- We'll run the verification steps today and push results back to you (expected by EOD PT).
- We'd like a short 30-minute technical review with runtime + platform owners to walk the annotated timeline and the planned guard. Can you do Thu 2027-05-27 10:00 PT? Please send calendar invite with a meeting link.

Also, on a separate note: do you anticipate any change to the SLA or credits process for incidents of this class? We'll hold that discussion for the review but wanted to flag it.

Appreciate the thoroughness — Alex
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Alex —

Meeting invite sent for Thu 2027-05-27 10:00 PT (30 min). Agenda: 1) walk annotated timeline, 2) discuss kernel-heuristic guard and verification plan, 3) next steps on runbook + post-fix soak. Calendar link: https://cal.redwood.ai/meet/ins-20270527-sentrypay

Thanks — looking forward to the review.
